item.text: The tracing setup is currently in `internal/cmd/grpc.go`, including a process-wide `sync.Once` exporter cache that can leak configuration between independent server starts. I’m moving resource/provider/exporter construction into `internal/tracing` and will keep the server responsible only for registering those components and their shutdowns.
